sentences.text: So a director at the Rexx Pharmaceutical Company argued that the government should subsidize the development costs for the new vaccines that the health department asked them for.
And the reason is that marketing vaccines is going to be less profitable than marketing any other pharmaceutical product.

And to support that, the director says vaccine sales are likely to be lower, because each vaccine only gets administered to a patient once, whereas medicines that treat diseases and chronic illnesses get administered many times to each patient.
